## Source and method

- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/schema.json
- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/dist/exercises.json
- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/LICENSE.md
- https://wger.de/api/v2/exercisecategory/
- https://wger.de/api/v2/equipment/
- https://wger.de/api/v2/muscle/
- https://github.com/wger-project/wger/blob/master/README.md
- https://oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/bodyparts
- https://oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/equipments
- https://oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/muscles
- https://github.com/ExerciseDB/exercisedb-api/blob/main/LICENSE

Every category, equipment, muscle and body-part term three open exercise databases publish, read up to 2026-11-05: free-exercise-db's JSON Schema enums, the wger REST API v2 lists, and the ExerciseDB v1 open API lists, each term spelled as its source spells it. Plus the 6 of free-exercise-db's 876 exercise names that share a key with a constant. Set against HealthKit's HKWorkoutActivityType cases and Health Connect's ExerciseSessionRecord and ExerciseSegment constants from this site's workout-types crosswalk. A term is mapped only when it is a database category or an exercise name and its key equals a constant's key; key = the name lowercased with a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ or EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_ removed and every character outside a-z0-9 removed. Equipment, muscle and body-part terms name no activity and are never mapped. nameContains lists constants whose words contain the term's words in order: a text coincidence shown for browsing, not a mapping. The databases' own licenses apply to their content (free-exercise-db: Unlicense (public domain); wger: Exercise data under Creative Commons licenses set per entry; code AGPL-3.0-or-later; ExerciseDB v1: Repository LICENSE is AGPL-3.0; no separate data license found); this dataset republishes only the term names and the derived match columns.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `database` | free-exercise-db, wger or ExerciseDB v1 | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `facet` | category, equipment, muscle, body-part, or exercise (an exercise name that matched) | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `term` | The term exactly as the database spells it | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `databaseId` | wger's numeric id; null where the database gives none | integer, null | 120 of 155 rows |
| `englishName` | wger's English name for a muscle; null where it gives none | null, string | 145 of 155 rows |
| `key` | DERIVED: lowercased, a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ or EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_ removed, characters outside a-z0-9 removed | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `status` | DERIVED: mapped when a category or exercise name has the same key as a constant; otherwise unmapped | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `healthkit` | DERIVED: HKWorkoutActivityType cases with the same key (mapped rows only) | null | 155 of 155 rows |
| `healthConnect` | DERIVED: ExerciseSessionRecord.EXERCISE_TYPE_* constants with the same key | null, string | 152 of 155 rows |
| `healthConnectSegment` | DERIVED: ExerciseSegment.EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_* constants with the same key | null, string | 149 of 155 rows |
| `nameContainsHealthkit` | DERIVED: HealthKit cases whose name contains the term as whole words. A text coincidence, not a mapping | null, string | 148 of 155 rows |
| `nameContainsHealthConnect` | DERIVED: Health Connect exercise types whose name contains the term as whole words. Not a mapping | null, string | 151 of 155 rows |
| `nameContainsSegment` | DERIVED: Health Connect segment types whose name contains the term as whole words. Not a mapping | null, string | 137 of 155 rows |
| `reason` | Why the row is mapped or unmapped | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `source` | The source the term was read from | string | 0 of 155 rows |
| `page` | This site's row | string | 0 of 155 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/exerciseTaxonomy.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-exercise-taxonomy.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-11-05.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
